source_documents.title: A novel approach to supramolecular Aggregation-Induced emission using tetracationic tetraphenylethylene and sulfated beta-Cyclodextrin

reference_evidence_units.quote: corresponding to an approximate 84-fold enhancement in emission intensity
reference_evidence_units.subject: ALITPE with sulfated beta-cyclodextrin (SCD)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 31.3 micromolar ALITPE in water; SCD titration, Fig. 1.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Emission increases approximately 84-fold up to around 6.5 micromolar SCD, then decreases with excess SCD.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The response is nonmonotonic. Do not summarize all increases in host concentration as fluorescence enhancement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: When it aggregates in the presence of polyanionic supramolecular SCD, the intramolecular rotation of the free ALITPE molecule becomes restricted
reference_evidence_units.subject: ALITPE with SCD
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation of the concentration-dependent fluorescence and charge-neutralized assemblies.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors connect oppositely charged host-guest association, aggregation and restriction of ALITPE rotation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The rotation mechanism is inferred, not a directly measured torsional potential.

reference_evidence_units.quote: notably slow decay of the complex
reference_evidence_units.subject: ALITPE with SCD
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Time-resolved anisotropy at 31.3 micromolar ALITPE and 6.5 micromolar SCD, Fig. 5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: An anisotropy fit gives rotational correlation time around 2.8 ns and residual anisotropy around 0.15; the source also reports DLS aggregates around 150 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Whole-assembly rotation is not internal phenyl rotation. DLS is reported in the main text but underlying SI Fig. S3 is unavailable.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the inefficiency of unsubstituted βCD molecules in inducing the aggregation of ALITPE molecules
reference_evidence_units.subject: ALITPE with native beta-cyclodextrin versus SCD
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Native-host control, Fig. 6, compared with sulfated host.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The weak response with native beta-cyclodextrin supports an important role for the charged sulfate groups rather than a generic cyclodextrin cavity.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A comparative interpretation of fluorescence, not an atomically resolved binding measurement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: it takes around 80 mM of NaCl to reduce the fluorescence intensity of this supramolecular aggregate until it reaches the emission level of the free dye in water
reference_evidence_units.subject: ALITPE with SCD under salt titration
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 31.3 micromolar ALITPE and 6.5 micromolar SCD; NaCl additions, Fig. 7-9.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Increasing salt reduces fluorescence towards the free-dye level near 80 mM. Absorption/scattering and lifetime trends support loss of the emitting assemblies.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Salt tolerance is finite. Do not turn a relative tolerance comparison into a claim that salt leaves the assembly unaffected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the absorption spectra revealed an increment in the long-wavelength offset
reference_evidence_units.subject: ALITPE with SCD under heating
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 31.3 micromolar ALITPE and 6.5 micromolar SCD; Figs. 11-13, temperature-dependent spectra and lifetimes.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Heating reduces emission and lifetime while increasing the long-wavelength absorption offset. The displayed curves were checked; the source interprets the offset as increased turbidity/aggregation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Unlike the salt and excess-host responses, thermal quenching is not assigned to aggregate disassembly. Scattering is a proxy for aggregation, not a quantitative aggregate count.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Since the temperature increase does not lead to the dissociation
reference_evidence_units.subject: ALITPE with SCD under heating
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation of simultaneous temperature-dependent absorption, fluorescence and lifetime measurements.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors attribute thermal quenching to increased nonradiative molecular motion while aggregates remain present.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The claim of a sole cause is the authors' interpretation; no independent separation of radiative and nonradiative rates is provided here.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The Autodock Vina was used to perform molecular docking calculations.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ALITPE and SCD
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PM3-optimized inputs, docking with a 40 angstrom cubic search box, exhaustiveness 1000; successive docking builds 1:1 and 2:1 models.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Docking explores plausible host-guest arrangements and interactions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Selected geometries are model hypotheses, not experimental determination of stoichiometry, cavity occupancy or aggregate morphology.

reference_evidence_units.quote: stabilize ALITPE on the surface of SCD
reference_evidence_units.subject: ALITPE and SCD
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation of docking in Fig. 15 and the host/salt experiments.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source describes electrostatic and other noncovalent contacts at the SCD surface.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not equate surface association with verified cavity inclusion. Docked pi contacts alone do not establish H/J excitons or excimer emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: there were no significant enhancement in the fluorescence intensity of ALITPE
reference_evidence_units.subject: ALITPE without SCD
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Main-text summary of control experiments varying NaCl, pH and temperature; SI Fig. S4-S6 not supplied.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source reports no significant turn-on for free ALITPE under the tested perturbations, supporting a role for SCD.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Underlying control plots are unavailable. This is not a statement that free-dye fluorescence is invariant under every possible condition.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source attributes emission enhancement to restricted rotation and thermal quenching to nonradiative molecular motion in still-aggregated material. The assignment remains indirect.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The host-induced aggregate environment constrains molecular motion. Assembly is supported; specific packing geometry is not resolved.

reference_mechanisms.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Oppositely charged host-guest association is central to the source account and supported by native-host and salt controls. Retain surface association without asserting deep cavity inclusion.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific charge-transfer assignment or diagnostic comparison is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer mechanism is established. Changing solution pH or ground-state protonation alone does not establish ESIPT.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No photoinduced electron-transfer pathway is established by the selected source evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Particle formation and AIE alone do not establish H/J excitonic or excimer emission; no such target assignment is established here.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Lifetime or intensity changes alone do not isolate radiative rates or a distinct bright/dark-state mechanism. Do not duplicate a generic nonradiative explanation as a separate established pathway.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-mediated or energy-transfer mechanism is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection calculation or assignment is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state emissive mechanism or anti-Kasha assignment is established in the selected evidence.
